selection: Six whole v0.4.6 theme files (Type, AppTextStyles, AdaptiveAccentColorPolicy, AndroidNativeVariantThemePolicy, AppDisplayPolicy, Color) plus the five upstream design-system theme tests that exercise them.
purpose: Emit the six files verbatim from the appearance producer and exclude the six direct-mode v0.2.5 copies; emit the five original tests into the producer test root. One Windows call site changes: the carried v0.4.6 Typography.toMiuixTextStyles() pins the native Miuix titles to a fixed 32/24/20/18sp Medium scale, so DesktopAppearanceTheme.kt now converts the Material baseline first and applies the font size and weight presets to the resulting TextStyles through the desktop-owned resolveDesktopMiuixTextStyles (DesktopMiuixTextStyles.kt), the order the original Theme.kt uses. The carried v0.4.3 Theme.kt is not compiled (the appearance producer emits no PureBiliBiliTheme), so the Windows theme is the only consumer.
typographyDecision: R-T1 (Root, 2026-10-19): adopt the v0.4.6 Material baseline typography as is, with no extra 4K compensation. The desktop app has its own display scale (default 125 percent times the Windows scale); bodySmall 13 to 12sp and labelSmall 12 to 11sp are accepted.
typographyDecisionEffects: Sizes and line heights: bodySmall 13 to 12sp and labelSmall 12 to 11sp; line heights bodyMedium 21 to 20sp, bodySmall 19 to 16sp, labelMedium 17 to 16sp (labelSmall stays 16sp).

Letter spacing: the v0.2.5 scale set every slot to 0sp. The v0.4.6 baseline carries the Material 3 spec values (bodyLarge 0.5, bodyMedium 0.25, bodySmall 0.4, labelLarge 0.1, labelMedium 0.5, labelSmall 0.5, titleMedium 0.15, titleSmall 0.1sp, displayLarge -0.25sp), and they now apply to CJK text. The values listed are the carried AppTextStyles tokens; the compiled Md3Typography is androidx Typography(), which follows the same Material 3 spec (not read from a class file here).

lineHeightStyle: the v0.2.5 scale gave every slot LineHeightStyle(Center, Trim.None) so CJK glyphs were centred in fixed-height components. The v0.4.6 baseline has none, so that centring falls back to the Compose default.

Native Miuix titles: v0.2.5 mapped title1..title4 to displayLarge, headlineLarge, headlineMedium and headlineSmall (57/32/28/24sp). v0.4.6 uses a fixed 32/24/20/18sp scale with 38/30/26/24sp line heights, Medium weight.

Windows pipeline: the font size and weight presets are applied to the converted Miuix TextStyles (resolveDesktopMiuixTextStyles), not to the Material typography before the conversion, so they still reach title1..title4.
Needs a visual check of CJK rendering on the real 5120x2160 window (Root); R-T1 keeps the display scale (Ctrl+wheel or the appearance setting) as the remedy instead of a typography compensation.
notCarried: design-system/src/main/java/com/android/purebilibili/core/ui/components/AdaptivePreferenceComponents.kt (platform-adapter-reference; Windows ships its own preference entry)
